- The previous blocker record said first publication of `@eunomia-bpf/agentsight` remained unverified because an earlier 6 August publish attempt failed.
- Current authoritative release evidence resolves that blocker. On exact v1.0.30 release commit `934f441eff8ca210807333633f47b2efcb8cd020`, GitHub check `Publish @eunomia-bpf/agentsight` completed successfully in workflow run `32803690960`.
- The job log synced and validated npm package version `1.0.30`, then executed `npm publish --access public` and terminated with `+ @eunomia-bpf/agentsight@1.0.30`, including npm provenance publication.
- Independent public evidence also reports a successful `npm view @eunomia-bpf/agentsight` and `npx --yes @eunomia-bpf/agentsight --help` for an earlier 1.0.15 version.
- The first-publication blocker is therefore removed. This does not add npm to the website install recommendations: the current authoritative product README/release surface still determines which installation paths should be promoted publicly.
